about: Known-answer vectors from Lovejoin (https://github.com/logical-mechanism/Lovejoin, MIT, crypto/test-vectors at fa5b605): every Schnorr (provedlog) vector, 10 sigma-OR vectors for each N in 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, the Schnorr and sigma-OR negatives, and 80 encoding-parity cases (Fiat-Shamir inputs, and serialise_data of output references). Hex throughout; scalars are big-endian hex.
